# SD13-E5 Ranger level 10 hybrid chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 10 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-10 hybrid baseline, mirroring the
# level-9 fixture's shape with the class level swapped. The PF1 CRB Ranger
# class table's level-10 "Special" column reads "3rd favored enemy, combat
# style feat" (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and
# legacy.aonprd.com). The THIRD combat-style bonus feat is grounded by this
# slice as a restricted-list choice recognition mirroring the level-2/6
# grants exactly (the Archery style's own 10th-level list adds Pinpoint
# Targeting and Shot on the Run; this fixture selects Shot on the Run). The
# "3rd favored enemy" interval (a third enemy-type selection PLUS the
# rule's own second +2 bonus-increase-target choice) is a real,
# newly-discovered multi-record burden deliberately left named-but-unproven
# this slice — mirroring exactly how the level-8 "2nd favored terrain"
# multi-record burden was deferred — so this fixture carries NO third
# favored-enemy selection and NO second increase-target choice, and nothing
# is fabricated for either.
#
# Level 8's PF1 Core Rulebook "Special" column names TWO entries (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com): "Swift tracker" (an
# automatic, no-choice class feature) and "2nd favored terrain" (a
# player-choice feature mirroring the Favored Enemy 5th-level idiom, left
# named-but-unproven this slice per the operator brief's one-new-record cap).
# Favored Enemy's next interval is 10th level, and the Combat Style Feat's next
# bonus feat lands at 10th level too, so this fixture carries forward the same
# favored-enemy (both types and the bonus-increase target), combat-style (both
# bonus feats), favored-terrain, and hunter's-bond selections from the level-7
# fixture unchanged.
